_comment: Client configuration for pm2-mcp. This is the real block used on forge, not a sketch.
Two forms are shown: paste ONE of them (without this _comment key) into your client.
There is no auth field because there is no authentication — see docs/threat-model.md.
The URL must stay on 127.0.0.1. Anything that can reach this port can stop or restart
every PM2 process on the host.
